about_the_game:
Build the weapon of your dreams

Build a weapon from components to fight the incoming enemy waves. Use projectiles and modifiers to make a near infinite number of combinations. Upgrade your components and get new ones to improve your weapon. Do you want to build a gun that shoots cabbages that grow really big so they hit all the enemies? Or perhaps you want to program a gun where sawblades pierce all the enemies and huge amount of chain lightning against them? Everything is possible!

Weapon is built left to right

There are 2 different types of components, projectiles and modifiers each serving their unique purpose. Modifiers change and add properties for the projectile and projectiles are the ones that are actually fired from the gun. All the modifers to the left of a projectile will affect that projectile.

Choose your battles

Choose what you want to fight against, do you want to fight a huge swarm of enemies? Or perhaps you want to fight only hoppers or crabs. You can also choose based on the rewards; some waves will be more challenging, but you can get more rewards for beating those waves!

Mutations improve your components

Mutate components to make them even stronger! You can have up to 5 mutations on a single component. You can also merge three of the same components to improve its rank! 

More cannons more fun

Program one large weapon and two smaller weapons to reach the furthest wave possible! Now with a total of 23 total slots for your components!
